items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But Jack Cooler, the artist, his old friend of mine... [INTERVIEWEE] He outdid himself on that.

ctx.x: But Jack Cooler, the artist, his old friend of mine, that's right.
He outdid himself on that. Somebody was misinformed. He outdid himself on that.
